issues.where: crops C, I and M, the upper right limb and night side
issues.what: the aurora is a row of separate, smeared green blobs painted over the globe. It does not sit as a curtain above the limb, and loose green smudges float in the middle of the night side. It reads as a 2D overlay with halo bleed, not a lit volume above the surface
issues.fix: render the aurora as a thin emissive band at altitude that follows the limb, with soft vertical rays and continuous falloff. Remove the stray green patches inside the disc

issues.where: right night-side limb (crops I and R in image-06/07)
issues.what: a pale grey-brown landmass patch (West Africa) shows on the dark side with a hard, stamped-in outline. The night side around it looks semi-transparent, and the Milky Way shows through near the limb
issues.fix: keep the night side fully opaque and dark-shaded so the land texture shows only through city lights and faint earthshine. Blend the patch edge

issues.where: crops H and A, the Andes and the Amazon
issues.what: the terrain is over-sharpened and embossed into a plastic, airbrushed relief. The Andes ridge has a bright halo edge, and the Amazon is a flat, painterly green with soft, smeared detail at native size
issues.fix: reduce the normal/bump strength and the sharpening, and add real high-frequency albedo detail (rivers, mottled forest) instead of a smooth fill

issues.where: crops A, F and P, the clouds over the Pacific and the Caribbean
issues.what: the clouds are soft, painterly cotton streaks. They have no fine structure and no cast shadows, and they look airbrushed at native size. The hurricane spiral is overly smooth
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution cloud layer with fine cellular detail, slight shadowing onto the ocean, and a sharper structure in the eyewall

issues.where: South America, the terminator region (crops H and V)
issues.what: city lights burn on land that is still in full daylight colour. The day-night blend is a broad, muddy fade rather than a lit terminator
issues.fix: mask the night lights by the light term, and tighten the terminator with a warm transition band

issues.where: crop V, near the southern limb
issues.what: a green smear sits on the open ocean at the limb with no aurora context. It looks like a stray object
issues.fix: remove it, or tie it to the auroral oval

issues.where: the sky, lower left and upper left
issues.what: a few bright stars are slightly elongated or doubled blobs rather than crisp points
issues.fix: render the stars as point sprites of 1–2 px with consistent PSFs

issues.where: crops B, D and F, the left limb
issues.what: the atmosphere glow is a uniform, saturated cyan rim of even width, which looks a little like an outer-glow effect
issues.fix: vary the scattering by sun angle, thinner and dimmer away from the sub-solar side

issues.where: bottom of globe over South America night side (crop P in image-15.png, crops A and E in image-14.png)
issues.what: the landmass cuts off in an abrupt horizontal shelf lined with vertically stretched, blocky yellow rectangles instead of point city lights, with a flat smeared interior and a plastic clay-like ridge along the western coast
issues.fix: replace the clipped continent patch and stretched light bars with continuous high-resolution night terrain and crisp, naturally clustered point city lights that follow real coastlines to the limb

issues.where: lower-right Milky Way sky (crops E and H in image-14.png, crops Q and R in image-15.png, crops V and W in image-16.png)
issues.what: stars and nebula detail in the lower-right sky are smeared diagonally into soft, fuzzy blobs and streaks that contrast sharply with the pinpoint stars in the upper-left sky
issues.fix: render the Milky Way and starfield at full native resolution with unstretched, point-like stars matching the sharpness of the rest of the sky

issues.where: globe limb and right-side aurora (crops A, C, F, G and I in image-14.png, crops K, L and Q in image-15.png)
issues.what: a hard cyan-white inner line creates a doubled edge inside the sunlit atmospheric glow, while the right-limb aurora looks airbrushed with blotchy red noise outside the limb, flat green smears over the clouds, and limb-stretched city-light streaks
issues.fix: replace the hard inner rim with a smooth volumetric atmospheric falloff and render the aurora as an elevated volumetric emission layer rather than painted surface and halo smears

issues.where: daylit continents and lower-left limb clouds (crops A, C and F in image-14.png)
issues.what: North and Central American terrain looks painterly and airbrushed with crunchy oversharpening on western deserts, soft coastlines, and clouds stretching parallel to the lower-left limb
issues.fix: use higher-resolution, properly projected Earth albedo, relief, and cloud maps so surface and cloud detail stay crisp and unstretched out to oblique limb angles

issues.where: foreground sunlit ocean surface (crops A, F and G in image-10.png, crop P in image-11.png, crops U and V in image-12.png)
issues.what: the ocean sun-glint zone shows coarse, oversized wave striations and directional shimmer that read as a stretched miniature water bump map at orbital altitude
issues.fix: scale down the ocean normal-map frequency to orbital proportions so specular sun glint resolves as fine, scale-accurate sea texture

issues.where: Cuba and Florida landmasses and upper horizon glow (crops B, C, E and I in image-10.png, crops K, Q and R in image-11.png)
issues.what: small clouds and land features over Cuba and Florida soften into slightly painterly blotches at native size, and the upper limb and top-center lens glare show a faint stepped cyan band and subtle gradient banding
issues.fix: increase native-resolution coastal and cumulus texture fidelity and apply dithering and a smoother falloff to the atmospheric limb and upper sky glare
